notes.title: 🧙 Free Prologue out now!
notes.content:
For those of you who tuned into Wholesome Direct, you already know—the free prologue of Fantastic Haven is out now!

Develop your Haven and explore the surrounding region to rescue astonishing creatures. Restore magic through taking care of creatures and rehabilitating them into their natural habitat, and discover the different points of interest to get a glimpse of what the full game's mechanics will have to offer.

[previewyoutube=wsD2KniDznE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Play now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719840/Fantastic_Haven_Prologue

As always, if you like it, it would be awesome if you could leave a positive review to help us with the launch!

Thank you ♥
-Piece of Cake Fabulous & Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: ✨ Fantastic Haven's prologue is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have some exciting news about Fantastic Haven!
First and foremost, thank you for your support; the project is progressing well, and that's why we have some great updates. Next year, you'll have the opportunity to try out a prologue for the game!

Get ready to rescue your first fantastic creatures very soon. We're counting on you to restore magic!

[previewyoutube=Hfp7TS-7nVc;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Prologue Features:[/b][/u]

[list][*] Encounter, save, and reintroduce 4 magical creatures.
[*] Unlock and manage 10 unique buildings.
[*] Explore a captivating region.
[*] Engage with 7 narrative events shaping the destiny of Fantastic Haven.[/list]

ICYMI: a Kickstarter campaign is in the works! Follow the project now to be notified of its launch. ♥

Happy holidays, and see you for a glorious 2024!

notes.title: Introducing Fantastic Haven 🧙
notes.content:
[i]In a world where magic is gradually disappearing in favor of technological advances that threaten the balance, you play the role of the Elders, protectors of the continent.
While the inhabitants prefer to hunt the creatures and gradually abandon magic, your mission is to restore the balance by saving the fantasy creatures, while using diplomacy and teaching to convince people to live in harmony with them.[/i]

[h2]FANTASTIC HAVEN EARLY ACCESS COMING IN Q2 2024![/h2]

[previewyoutube=rt0-s-UPDrE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Main Features:[/h3]

[b]Establish a refuge[/b] - Choose where your refuge will be and build basic infrastructures unlocking new research and buildings, allowing you to welcome more creatures and make your refuge prosper.

[b]Welcome Creatures One and All[/b] - Bring creatures back to the refuge and rehabilitate them. Place them in proper quarantine structures, then move them to a sanctuary with other compatible creatures and their biotope while keeping them sequestered from others. When the time is right, set them back into the wild, helping to restore magic.

[b]Explore the Realm[/b] - Send out scouting parties of mages to survey points of interest and to find creatures in need and bring them back to your refuge. While exploring, be sure to collect the five types of ether to use as currency and fuel your creations.

[b]Bring Harmony[/b] - Negotiate with hostile populations using diplomacy to form strong ties. Train your citizens to properly care for the fantastical creatures at the refuge to increase its reputation and to help bring balance between humans, creatures, resources, and magic. 

[b][h3]🐉 [u]WISHLIST NOW[/u] 🐉[/h3][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2556470/Fantastic_Haven/

[hr][/hr]

The Piece of Cake and Goblinz teams are really proud and excited to bring this exciting project to life. We can't wait to share regular news about the game and get your impressions! 
Stay tuned here on Steam, on [url=https://twitter.com/fantastic_haven]social media[/url], or in our [url=https://e3ccac1c.sibforms.com/serve/MUIFAOev7cwJ-QcrA7tQpLzSY0Qv6pAg3i-XInR9Aa45-zLbsLh7zwSSqJlj7VQuwQfh0dxQLvIoDrC3mPAVTorgS5HsBotACbU0DYBvepq111AVg906JCyTRvBjghjEKCBhUn_zDyec6jpAnlpZ4eQ3-uP3AqxQsMIBNi8XfTeBjg24Xn8vGK0j-MkoTv1op485GVWJIbeTrryC]newsletter[/url] to stay up-to-date with the development progress and other exciting news. 
A [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/goblinzstudio/fantastic-haven?ref=ix2ffg]Kickstarter campaign[/url] is also on the way and will be available in November — follow the project now and get notified for launch!
